queries.query: Look for studies on the antitumoral effects of organometallic complexes, particularly the succinimido-ferrociphenol compound, in pancreatic cancer where the publication year is 2026.
Look for datasets related to the Iberian cryoEM community where the research involves macromolecular complexes and is scheduled for public release on June 2, 2026.
Look for research on sub-stoichiometric fluorite oxides like (U1-yCey)O2-x where the publication year is expected to be 2026 and the temperature is less than 400°C.
Look for studies on uranium oxidation states in single hot particles where the publication year is expected to be 2027 and the experiment is conducted between March 2-4, 2024.
Look for research on strained infinite-layer nickelate membranes where the publication year is 2027 and the study involves Ni L3-edge RIXS.
Look for research on stress-induced martensitic transformation in beta titanium alloys where the publication year is expected to be 2027 and the study focuses on the effect of alloying elements.
Find research on biomedical projects involving membrane proteins and eukaryotic proteins where the experiment session is scheduled for November 14 to 15, 2024.
Look for research on proteins related to pathogenesis of diseases that includes viral proteins and was conducted using the ID30A-1 instrument.
Look for research on bone structural adaptation in deep-sea teleost fishes where the publication year is 2025.

Find datasets related to 3D XRDCT of YSZ/NI fuel cell samples from the experiment session at ESRF conducted between November 8 and November 10, 2022, with results expected to be released on November 10, 2025.

Look for studies on static sequential infiltration synthesis into Polystyrene-block-Maltoheptaose where the environment temperature is at room temperature and the publication year is 2021.
Look for research on ZIF-8 and methane conducted at an environment temperature of 0.2°C and using the IN5 cold neutron multichopper spectrometer in 2014.
Look for research proposals involving the D50 T tomograph where the sample formula includes Si, O, K, Al, Na and the publication year is 2018.
